from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from core.agent_capability_policy import PolicyContext
from modules.agent_harness.module_agent_reach_adapter import ModuleAgentReachError,ModuleExternalResearchRequest,authorize_module_external_research
from modules.agent_harness.marketing_public_research import authorize_marketing_public_research

def ctx():
    caps=frozenset({'EXTERNAL_RESEARCH'}); scopes=frozenset({'external:web','empresa:1','unidad:2'})
    limits={'runtime_seconds':30,'files_changed':0,'lines_changed':0,'external_calls':1,'sql_rows':0,'inference_cost_usd':0.0}
    return PolicyContext(caps,caps,caps,caps,scopes,scopes,scopes,scopes,limits)

def auth(allowed=True,unidad=2): return {'allowed':allowed,'module_code':'MARKETING','permission':'MARKETING','empresa_id':1,'unidad_id':unidad}

def test_marketing_authorized_through_execution_gate():
    gate,policy=authorize_marketing_public_research(request_id='m1',empresa_id=1,unidad_id=2,query='tendencias publicas restaurantes mexico',requester_authorization=auth(),context=ctx())
    assert gate.allowed is True
    assert gate.downstream is not None
    assert policy.production_allowed is False
    assert policy.budgets.external_calls==1

def test_fail_closed_rbac_scope_budget():
    req=ModuleExternalResearchRequest('x','MARKETING','MARKETING',1,2,'consulta publica')
    with pytest.raises(ModuleAgentReachError,match='REQUESTER_RBAC_DENIED'): authorize_module_external_research(req,auth(False),ctx())
    with pytest.raises(ModuleAgentReachError,match='REQUESTER_BUSINESS_SCOPE_MISMATCH'): authorize_module_external_research(req,auth(True,99),ctx())
    with pytest.raises(ModuleAgentReachError,match='EXTERNAL_CALL_BUDGET_MUST_EQUAL_ONE'): ModuleExternalResearchRequest('x','MARKETING','MARKETING',1,2,'q',2)

def test_no_direct_runtime_executor_dependency():
    text=Path('modules/agent_harness/module_agent_reach_adapter.py').read_text()
    assert 'agent_reach_public_search_executor' not in text
    assert 'agent_reach_runtime_executor' not in text
    assert 'execute_agent_reach_public_search' not in text
